title: Commonwealth Bank Ultimate Award Credit Card: No Fee for a Month with $4,000 Spend in a Statement Period (Normally $35/Month)
body:
Deal: Commonwealth Bank Ultimate Award Credit Card: No Fee for a Month with $4,000 Spend in a Statement Period (Normally $35/Month)

[Mokr] Earn up to $900 in Travel Credits when you spend $9,000 or more on eligible purchases with your new Ultimate Awards credit card within 90 days of opening your card and keep your account open for more than 12 months
Hodl
[sunyuanxin] Kinda surprised they haven't moved to an annual fee yet. NAB's signature rewards card is changing from October, no more waiving the $35 monthly fee with $5k monthly spend. It's just a $395 annual fee now. Meanwhile, CBA still lets you avoid the $35 monthly fee by spending $4k a month.
[ansi2cn] For $35, are you going to spend $4000 every month on this credit card? Yes, I have a 25,000 credit card limit; I have never exceeded 1,000 for a family of four. I book flight tickets for insurance, but I repay within the cycle.
[mskeggs] Can't fly 4 people very far for under $1000.
[ansi2cn] @mskeggs: I mentioned limit with 25000 :-) i.e card limit and $1000 monthly spending
[Domingo] @ansi2cn: You said you'd never exceeded $1,000. A limit of $25,000 is somewhat irrelevant if you've never exceeded $1,000 spend.
[ansi2cn] @Domingo: True, I just hold it for emergencies. Getting that limit is not possible. I tried other banks, but they all stayed at $10,000, so I decided to keep it with ANZ.
[Domingo] @ansi2cn: Can't fly 4 people very far for under $1000.
[Weshouldgetsushi] Look at Mr Fancypants here. 25,000 limit.
[Oh Boy] Only idiots will get under debt.
Smart ones will use the interest free cycle and rewards in their favour.
[mulder1989] It's ok to have debt if you have someone to pay it for you.
[Skinnerr] That tracks because our government is in record debt since federation.
[tenpercent] Not true. There have been times when the federal government has had no debt.
[Oh Boy] Yeah coz they gave people money during lockdowns to pay their credit card bills
[ansi2cn] If their card spending is $4000 per month without touching the card debit. I really appreciate him.
[thisisscotts] I've had credit cards for the last two decades; missed one payment once because I forgot. Never "trapped under debt" - you just need to live within your means and pay before the due date.
[Morphisis] This CC isn't for everyone, and your comment clearly shows this isn't the card for you. You pick the right card for you, make the repayments on time and you're fine. No need for such a ridiculous comment.
[drhip] Wondering if you can earn bonus point on 2nd year with the wealth package or you need to cancel and reapply?
[payton] What do you people spend $4,000 per month on? Hookers and blow?
And here I thought Latitude's $1000 p/m to ward off the monthly fee is a PITA.
[Froot Loops] Neither my local hooker, nor dealer accept credit cards
[Oh Boy] Nah you gotta move to the inner city then. Cc accepted all around here baby.
Dealers and hookers have square.
[jv] What do you people spend $4,000 per month on?
Vic Labor spend that on dinner …
[SetTheFaqUp] "Vic Labor spend that"
They looked happy. Wonder how much they were charged for the tea.
[SetTheFaqUp] "Hookers"
Maybe full back, half back and five eighth.
[gsxr600rr] $200/week groceries (very conservative) - $800.
Health insurance for family - $500
Transport for 2 people 3 days in office - $12/day x 3 x 4 weeks x 2 people = $288.
Car insurance if you pay it monthly - $125
Childcare - $2000
Conservatively 1 meal out pp per week - $17 x 2 x 4 = $136
Mobile/internet/water/electricity - $300/month roughly maybe more.
Easily $4,149.
Now i havent even added any petrol, council rates, car CTP, clothes, random fixes that need doing, emergency fund.
Now you understand why people aint having kids cos that doesnt even include rent.
[gsxr600rr] Sold long time ago :) the bike meme is true.
[knobbs] You can pay your childcare fees on CC and not be smacked in the face with outrageous fees?
[2hit6] I am with this card for a while now. But I have to say, the reward program is not good. Very limited options
[Bon137] Good card if you travel OS. I pair this with AMEX ultimate. Works well for me.
[DebitATO] Can someone correct me but I read it as if you have a current mortgage with CBA all fee's waived for the Ultimate card?
[mattis] Certain mortgage packages with CBA include a no annual fee Ultimate Awards Mastercard (and some other cards, but I think the Ultimate Awards is one of the better):
MAV (Mortgage Advantage): https://www.commbank.com.au/support.home-loan.explain-mortga…
Wealth Package: https://www.commbank.com.au/home-loans/wealth-package.html
[bazingaa] Yes, I have it like that, and travel insurance is also free with this, also 2 free lounge access per year.
[excite] can you book a refundable luxury hotel for a few thousand to avoid the fee, then cancel next month?
[tenpercent] I'm not sure. But I just wanted to commend your thinking. The ozbargain spirit is within you.
[DingoBlue] Hasn’t this always been the case?
It’s a very lacklustre offering btw.
